newsitem.title: GERMANY: German April unemployment slightly down - sources.
newsitem.headline: German April unemployment slightly down - sources.

text.p: German unemployment in April fell in unadjusted terms to 4.347 million, or 11.3 percent of the workforce, from 4.477 in March, or 11.7 percent, according to sources who have access to official data to be released on Tuesday.
The sources told Reuters that the number of people out of work in west Germany slipped to 3.031 million, or 9.8 percent, and east German jobless totals fell to 1.315 million, or 17.5 percent.
In March, west German jobless totals were 3.127 million, an unemployment rate of 9.8 percent, and in east Germany 1.350 million people were out of work, a rate of 18.1 percent.
The figures are not adjusted for seasonal influences.
The Federal Labour Office is scheduled to release the official data at a news conference in Nuremberg on Tuesday.
